page_title: BET 2-0 VIL | Betis v Villarreal 17/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+6' Rodrigo Riquelme (Betis) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Victor Garcia had an easy-decision to make.
90+5' Betis are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
90+3' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) connects with the resulting free kick on the edge of the box, but can't find the target as his effort goes high over the bar.
90+3' Victor Garcia blows the whistle, Sergi Altimira (Betis) is penalised for a foul. Villarreal win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
90+2' Pablo Garcia (Betis) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
90+1' Renato Veiga (Villarreal) has a goal ruled out for offside!
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
89' It's time for a substitution. Angel Ortiz (Betis) comes on in place of Antony.
88' 11:13 – this is the current number of fouls committed by both teams.
86' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Marc Bartra (Betis) was quite harsh and Victor Garcia didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
85' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
83' 2 - 0 Pablo Fornals (Betis) scores! He latches on to a pass and produces a perfect strike from the edge of the box that goes inside the left post and past the goalkeeper.
82' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) commits a rough foul. Victor Garcia stops the game and makes a call.
81' Marcelino prepares a substitution. Alberto Moleiro is replaced by Carlos Macia (Villarreal).
81' Rodrigo Riquelme (Betis) guides an effort goalwards from the edge of the box, but it sails just wide of the left post.
80' Santiago Mourino (Villarreal) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.
79' A substitution has been made. Giovani Lo Celso goes off and Rodrigo Riquelme (Betis) comes on.
77' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
76' Santi Comesana (Villarreal) is sent off after deserving nothing other than a red card from a referee for clattering into his opponent!
75' Marcelino has decided to substitute Tajon Buchanan and he is replaced by Ayoze Perez (Villarreal).
74' Marcelino is stunned as referee Victor Garcia shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
74' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 13:7.
72' Pablo Garcia (Betis) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Chimy Avila.
71' Renato Veiga (Villarreal) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
70' Victor Garcia shows a yellow card to Valentin Gomez (Betis) for his blatant foul.
68' Alvaro Valles pulls off a great save to deny Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) who, makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive towards the middle of the goal.
67' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) does well on the edge of the box to find space and powers a shot in on goal that just goes over the bar.
65' Substitution. Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) replaces Gerard Moreno.
64' Villarreal are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
62' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
61' Marc Roca (Betis) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
59' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) commits a rough challenge and Victor Garcia blows his whistle for a foul.
57' 1 - 0 Goal! A mistake from the defence gifted a chance to a lurking Aitor Ruibal (Betis), who keeps his cool and rolls the ball into the net from close range. 1:0.
56' The ball possession is 61:39.
54' CLOSE! Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) shows off his amazing skills with a solo run to the edge of the box before fashioning a shot that whistles over the bar.
52' Flag up against Gerard Moreno (Villarreal). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
50' Villarreal take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
50' Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
49' Antony (Betis) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Victor Garcia has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
47' Pablo Fornals (Betis) is adjudged offside.
46' The game is over for Alfonso Pedraza. Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) comes on for the second half.
46' Marcelino has made a change at the break. Santiago Mourino (Villarreal) has come on in place of Pau Navarro.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' Victor Garcia has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
44' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Villarreal is cautioned for aggressive play.
42' Corner kicks – 1:2.
40' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
40' It seemed like Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
38' Villarreal keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
36' Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) goes into the book for bad language. His vulgar comments could have made it worse. Luckily for him, it's a yellow card.
34' The ball is cleared after Chimy Avila (Betis) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
32' Villarreal are ruled offside.
30' Some great controlled play and passing from Villarreal. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
28' Referee Victor Garcia sees the trip by Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
27' Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
25' Total attempts – 5:1.
23' Pau Navarro (Villarreal) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
21' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Victor Garcia blows his whistle for a foul.
20' Betis are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
18' Valentin Gomez (Betis) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
16' Antony (Betis) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the bottom right corner, but Luiz Junior is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
14' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
12' The ratio of the ball possession is 58:42.
10' Betis players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
8' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Villarreal comes to nothing.
7' The resulting set piece from Villarreal is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
6' Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. Villarreal will take a corner kick.
4' Chimy Avila (Betis) steadies himself on the edge of the box and releases a precise effort on goal that just narrowly sails past the right post.
3' Pablo Fornals (Betis) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Villarreal will have the kick-off.
Victor Garcia will officiate today.
